BodyKind.description: What a notice on a topic carries: the body-kind catalog (`ARC-115`). Adding a kind is one variant here, one in [`NoticeBody`](crate::NoticeBody) and its renderer, reviewed as a vocabulary change.

oneOf.description: Price lines: an item and an amount in minor units, with how many observations back it.
One line of text, 1 to 280 bytes.

EntityKey.description: An authoring key: the name of a file in people/, places/, items/ or organizations/ without .yaml. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

NoticeDuration.description: A duration written `"<n>m"`, `"<n>h"` or `"<n>d"` (minutes, hours, days), such as `"6h"` or `"7d"`, from one minute to thirty days. Held in seconds.

PerDay.description: The most notices one publisher may post on a topic in any 24 hours of world time, 1 to 96 (Q-S31b-4: a rolling window of 86 400 s, not a calendar day).

Publishers.description: The people who may post on a topic: 1 to 16 person keys, none twice.

by_tag.description: A person tag, then the declared topics a person with that tag subscribes to, none twice.

body.description: What its notices carry: `prices` (item and amount lines) or `text` (one line).

per_day.description: The most notices one publisher may post on it in any 24 hours of world time, 1 to 96.

publishers.description: Who may post on it: 1 to 16 person keys.

valid_for.description: How long a notice on it may stay valid: `{ min, max }`, each "<n>m", "<n>h" or "<n>d".

TopicId.description: A topic's name: dotted lowercase segments, such as `prices.ingredients` or `news.daily`.

ValidFor.description: How long a notice on a topic may stay valid: from `min` to `max`, with `min` at most `max`.

max.description: The longest validity a notice on this topic may ask for, such as "48h"; at least `min`.

min.description: The shortest validity a notice on this topic may ask for, such as "1h".

description: A world's public-notice topics, and the default subscriptions by tag.

defaults.description: Default subscriptions. A person whose own file has no `notices:` section subscribes to the union of the topics listed for its tags.

topics.description: The world's topics, 1 to 32, each keyed by its dotted id such as prices.ingredients.
